reuse: Only immutable contribution arrays may be shared; each calculation owns its 47-value result. Live units/skills and mutable attributes are not cached.
supportedDomain: Plain Number-valued contribution objects without getters, strings or BigInt; absent properties map to zero because original code observes Number truthiness. Test qualification uses finite arithmetic plus falsy NaN/-0 contributions.
observerSemantics: recordFormula is emitted in source attribute order before immunity soft caps; finishStatic receives final capped values. Observers must not mutate shared contributions or the source attribute-name schema.
